faq.title: Frequently asked questions about 3D maps and keychains
faq.q1: What is a 3D city map and how is it different from a regular map?
faq.a1: A 3D city map is a three-dimensional tactile model of a district with real building heights, parks and rivers from OpenStreetMap data. Unlike a flat map, you can hold it, put it on a shelf or give it as a gift.
faq.q2: Can you make a 3D map of any city in the world?
faq.a2: Yes. In the Monadruk builder you can pick any point on Earth — from Kyiv and Lviv to New York or Paris — and create a 3D map of that district in minutes.
faq.q3: In what format do I get the file for 3D printing?
faq.a3: You download a ready 3MF file (and STL too) — it opens straight away in Bambu Studio or PrusaSlicer and is ready to print at home.
faq.q4: How much does a city map keychain or a 3D map cost?
faq.a4: A city map keychain starts at €3, a 3D district map from €6 for made-to-order printing. If you print yourself, downloading the ready file is free within your limit.
faq.q5: Can I order printing if I don't have a 3D printer?
faq.a5: Yes. We print your 3D map or keychain in eco-friendly Eco PLA bioplastic and ship the finished item.
faq.q6: Can I add my own text to the map keychain?
faq.a6: Yes — on a 55×30 mm map keychain you can add a city name or custom text printed in relief over the district map.
faq.q7: Can I get a keychain with mountain relief instead of streets?
faq.a7: Yes — that's the topo keychain. Switch on the “Terrain relief” mode in the builder and the token is printed with the real elevation relief of the place from satellite height data: the Alps, the Carpathians, fjords or a coastline. Peaks and valleys are readable with your fingers.
faq.a8: Right now we print and ship within Ukraine only (Nova Poshta, Ukrposhta). Abroad? Download the ready 3MF/STL file and print it at a local 3D-print studio.
faq.q9: What is a city-map fridge magnet?
faq.a9: A flat 3D-printed magnet of about 60 mm with the map of your neighbourhood: streets, parks and rivers in relief, with a pocket for a neodymium magnet on the back. A budget-friendly personal souvenir of a memorable place.

giftMeta.title: A gift with a 3D map & keychain
giftMeta.description: A tactile 3D city map or a keychain of a meaningful place — a warm, personal gift for an anniversary, wedding, birthday or housewarming. We print and ship across Ukraine.

gift.h1: A 3D map & keychain as a gift
gift.intro: Give a place that matters. The first date, a childhood yard, the city where it all began — we turn coordinates into a tactile 3D map or a keychain with its plan.
gift.intro2: Pick any point on Earth in the builder, add a caption — and we print and ship the finished gift, or hand you a print-ready file.
gift.anniversaryDesc: A map of where you first met or married — a symbolic gift that lasts for years. Add a date and the coordinates.
gift.birthdayDesc: A home neighbourhood, a favourite city or a dream destination as a 3D map — an unexpected, heartfelt gift.
gift.housewarmingDesc: A 3D map of the new neighbourhood or home — elegant decor for a wall or shelf for anyone who just moved in.
gift.coupleDesc: A heart-shaped pair keychain with the map of a shared place — one half for each of you. Carry the city that ties you together.
gift.corporateDesc: A map of the office, a branch city or a home region — an original gift for a colleague or partner. Bulk orders available.
gift.outro: Every gift is a 3D map of a real place: buildings, streets, terrain. Printed in eco PLA and shipped across Ukraine, or delivered as a ready 3MF to print yourself.

maket.h1: A physical model of your flat, from its floor plan
maket.subtitle: Upload a floor plan — we detect the walls, you confirm the dimensions, and in a few minutes you get a 3D model ready to print.
maket.uploadHint: A photo of a drawing, a scan, a developer's PDF or a screenshot — anything where the walls are visible.
maket.tipStraight: Shoot straight from above — tilt distorts the dimensions.
maket.tipWhole: The whole plan must fit in the frame, including the dimension lines.
maket.tipDimension: It helps if at least one dimension is legible — we read the scale from it.
maket.cvOnly: ⚠️ The neural model file is missing on this server, so only the simplified algorithm runs. It confuses hatching and labels with walls, so expect heavy manual correction. Ask the administrator to upload models/floorplan_seg.onnx.

toolHint.select: Tap a wall to select it. Drag the wall or its endpoint to move it. Delete removes it.
toolHint.draw: Drag to add a wall. Hold Shift to disable axis snapping.
toolHint.opening: Tap a wall to place a door. Tap again for a window, once more to remove.
toolHint.ruler: Drag along a known dimension and type its real length in metres.

maket.rulerAsk: How long is this line in reality?

scaleSource.reference: Set by you with the ruler — the most accurate option.
scaleSource.ocr: Read from the dimensions on the drawing. Please verify.
scaleSource.pdf: Taken from the vector PDF — exact.
scaleSource.door: Estimated from door width. Up to 15% off — better to refine it.
scaleSource.assumed: This is only a guess. Please set the scale with the ruler.
scaleSource.area: From the stated floor area. Please verify the dimensions.

maket.sizeSentence: Your space is {w} × {h} m, {a} m² of floor area. Correct?
maket.areaTooSmall: Too small — under 8 m². The scale looks too low.
maket.areaTooBig: Too large — over 400 m². The scale looks too high.
maket.trueScaleHeight: Print walls at true scale (taller walls mean a longer print and a less readable layout).
maket.genFailed: Could not build the model. Please try again.
maket.areaOutOfRange: Area must be between 5 and 600 m². Check the number.
maket.areaUnavailable: We couldn't measure the room area on this plan — set the scale with the ruler instead.

maketMeta.title: Floor plan to 3D printed model | Monadruk
maketMeta.description: Upload a floor plan and get a 3D model ready to print. Walls are detected automatically, you confirm the dimensions. Printing and delivery available.
maketMeta.keywords: floor plan to 3d model, 3d printed floor plan, apartment model, architectural maquette, floor plan 3d print
maketMeta.howToName: How to turn a floor plan into a 3D printed model
maketMeta.step2: Check the walls and set the scale
maketMeta.step3: Get the 3D model and order a print
maketMeta.seoH2: A model of your home, from your own plan
maketMeta.seoP1: We turn an ordinary drawing — a scan, a developer's PDF or even a phone photo of a paper plan — into a solid model you can hold. Walls are detected automatically, and you simply review the result and confirm the dimensions, which is exactly why the model comes out at the correct scale rather than merely looking similar.
maketMeta.seoP2: It makes a housewarming gift, a tangible reference during a renovation, or a keepsake of a home. Printed in PLA on an FDM printer, in 10, 15, 20 and 25 cm sizes along the longer side. You can also download the 3MF or STL file and print it yourself.
